_comment: Accepted one-word answers per class for clean-task correctness against the ground-truth class. Written once, after the clean answer distribution had been seen (the model answers 'dog' for nearly every breed, so breed-level answers are not a fair test of a one-word prompt). Entries are the class name, direct synonyms, or the unambiguous category noun. Normalization: lowercase, punctuation to spaces, whitespace collapsed. Scene or part words (e.g. 'gas station', 'tower') and wrong objects are not accepted.
